1. The dimensions mentioned in the indent specification is for estimation purpose only, but
actual measurement will be taken according to site condition after finalizing the by bidder.
The party shall visit the site and take the detailed drawing with dimensions for
manufacturng and the same has to be submitted for our approval before manufacturing.
However while quoting this proposal, the bidder should adhere the specification and M0C
as per our tender document.
2. Design, manufacture, testing &supply of mist eliminator filter element (Coalescing Filter) as
per the specification with Tank Gasket quantity 02 nos for Oil Mist Eliminator for 22.5 MW
BHEL make Frame-5 Gas Turbine Units at Puduchery Power Corporation Karaikal
including transportation, transit insurance, loading & unloading at site and taxes as
applicable and providing 18 (eighteen) months warranty for satisfactory performance of
filters.
3. The successful bidder shall provide warranty for 18 months from the date of installation
with free replacement against manufacturing defects, normal wear and tear during waranty
period.
4. The work/supply covers design, manufacture, testing &supply of Coalescing Filter Element
with Tank Gasket for Filter Element suitable for Oil Mist Eliminator OE-158B-500 Equivalent
toDollinger part number off element:95-137 for 22.5 MW BHEL make Frame-V Gas turbine
unit at puducherry power corporation, karaikal.
5. The successful bidder shall provide interchangeability certificate fo this mist eliminator filter
along with supply.
6. Successful bidder, with 20(Twenty) days of the issue ofLetter of Award (LoA) shallprovide
"Performance Bank Guarantee as per Performance Security for an amount equal to the 10%
of the total contract value with a validity period up to Warranty period (18 months) + 90
days for supply + 30(thirty) days claim period.
